01 / ABOUT

ABOUT HACKNOVA

HACKNOVA 2026 is a 24-hour hackathon organised by the Department of Artificial Intelligence at Hindusthan College of Science and Commerce, Ingur, Perundurai. Bring your ideas, collaborate with passionate minds and turn concepts into real-world solutions.

02 / RULES

THE RULES

Who can join

Arts & Science, Engineering, Polytechnic and other college students. Carry your valid college ID card.

Team size

4 to 5 members including the leader. One student can be in only one team.

Fee

₹300 per member, paid by bank transfer. Confirmed only after organizers verify your payment. Non-refundable once confirmed.

Original work

All code must be written during the 24 hours. Open-source libraries and public APIs are fine.

Submission

A working demo, source code on GitHub and a short presentation.

Fair play

Respect everyone. Plagiarism or false information leads to disqualification.
